note: Set B is superior because it extracts the General Sheet Notes (door swing, tilt/turn operation) and the Solar Envelope dimension, which are critical engineering constraints completely missed by Set A. Set A includes useful metadata like Sheet Title and Keynote P1 but incorrectly infers 'Roof' as an entity label instead of using the explicit 'Solar Envelope' or 'PV Array'. Set B has minor value formatting issues (appending 'feet-inches' to values), but its coverage of functional requirements and design envelopes makes it more faithful to the engineering content.
